items.title: Scrap junk to produce Cloth
items.detail: Craft Bulk Cloth at a Tinker's Workbench and scrap it for the fastest completion

items.title: Collect a Board Game
items.detail: Take from a Games Cupboard at your C.A.M.P. or use one at Whitespring Resort

items.title: Kill a Legendary Enemy
items.detail: Join public events like Eviction Notice, Radiation Rumble, or Uranium Fever

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Enter Daily Ops from World Activity on the map; Phantoms are masked cultists from the Slasher event

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Glass
items.detail: Craft Bulk Glass at a Tinker's Workbench and scrap it

items.title: Travel on foot (KM)
items.detail: Fast travel does not count; sprint on foot in open areas for faster progress

items.title: Use Photomode while in a Team
items.detail: Join any team and open Photomode to take a photo

items.title: Build a Decoration in a Shelter
items.detail: Enter your Shelter, access build menu, select Decorations category and place any item

items.title: Catch a Fish
items.detail: Fish at any water source; Fisherman's Rest in The Mire is recommended for combining with other challenges

items.title: Collect RadAway or Rad-X
items.detail: Collect from world loot or craft diluted forms at a chemistry station with Purified Water

items.title: Collect Soap
items.detail: Check showers and tables at Whitespring Resort exterior, or use a Whitespring Robo Butler Collectron

items.title: Collect a Board Game
items.detail: Take from a Games Cupboard at your C.A.M.P.

items.title: Eat a Vegetable
items.detail: Harvest and eat any raw vegetable like Tato, Corn, or Razorgrain

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Pint-Sized Phantoms appear in Daily Ops during the Slasher event phase

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation
items.detail: Look for gray cloudy areas on the map and search for Phantom mobs in the marked region

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Complete all six daily challenges on three separate days this week

events.description: Halloween-themed seasonal event featuring Scorched enemies with spooky cosmetics and exclusive rewards.
